unit.why: A single anecdote: the Seer of Lublin invites R. Menachem Mendel of Kosov for Rosh Hashana; he is prevented from going and sends his son to excuse him; the Seer responds, and R. Menachem Mendel dies that year.

stories.start_quote: בספר רמ"צ מביא שסיפר הרה״ק מפרשיסחא
stories.end_quote: ונסתלק בשנה ההוא א"ז פכ"ה אות כ״ד
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin invites his friend R. Menachem Mendel of Kosov for Rosh Hashana. His followers prevent him from going, so he sends his son R. Hayyim to excuse him. The Seer answers that a friend who needs to excuse himself does not really count as a friend, so he cannot do him good, and R. Menachem Mendel dies that year.
